verdict.rationale: Pigment documents detailed application histories down to the data-block level with full visibility into edit events, and an Audit Trail API that exports application events to a SIEM. Together these cover the logging half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows that changes can be rolled back; the staging and test environments are an adjacent control, not a rollback feature. Missing for 10: documented rollback or restore of model changes, explicit confirmation that history records who changed what and when, independent or hands-on corroboration.
